asks.name: gateway-already-attached
asks.message: The network will not take the gateway I made: one called shared-edge-igw is already attached to it, tagged EgressRef PLT-2208. Is that the one my public subnets are supposed to reach the internet through?

asks.name: segments-moved-off-my-table
asks.message: The subnets I bound to the table I stood up are on the table that was already here instead, and that table now reads edge-kept under RoutingRef NET-5521. Is that where they belong?

asks.name: my-default-route-disappeared
asks.message: The default route I put on my own table is gone, and the table that was already here reads single-path under EgressPathRef NSE-4471. Does the way out belong only on that one?

asks.name: segment-held-at-a-stage
asks.message: One of the subnets I cut now reads staged-hold under RolloutRef REL-3390 and has been bound to a table that goes nowhere. Should any part of my public tier stand in it?

asks.name: things-keep-changing
asks.message: Gateways, tables and subnets I did not create keep turning up in the network I was asked to use, and some of the routing I set keeps coming undone. Should what I build carry them, or only what I made myself?
asks.note: describes the effect without naming anything that was read; it reaches nobody

asks.name: generic
asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
